facts.name: AddPostProcessingPasses (function, not a mod constant)
facts.note: Found as the only big caller of the 1.004 sub_141118840 equivalent (0x14086A090) with the same View+0x1798 / Inputs layout. Much smaller in 1.005 (0x264C bytes vs 0x56E0): DOF and others are no longer inlined. Frame is now rbp-based (lea rbp,[rsp-630h]). View is in r14 (was r12), Inputs in r13 (was rdi), GraphBuilder in r12 (was r13).

facts.name: kOutputLoadActionSequence
facts.note: 90 bytes (was 125): 0x14118C65D..0x14118C6B7, from the end of the call to the (now out-of-line) stock CreateViewFamilyOutput through the end of the store. Same decision (Views[0] == View -> setz; +1 with dil = 1), but rcx is NOT the family at the store any more: rcx = [Inputs+10h] is loaded between the cmp and the setz and is the argument of the call at 0x14118C6C6. The family is [r14] (r14 = View, set at 0x14118C61C mov r14,rdx). A shorter 30-byte variant 0x14118C699..0x14118C6B7 = 498B06C5FA7F75B8488B084C3931498B4D100F94C04002C78885E0000000.

facts.name: kOutputLoadActionStore
facts.note: mov [rbp+0E0h], al: 6 bytes (was 7-byte mov [rsp+610h], al). One instruction, inside the aligned 16-byte block 0x14118C6B0..0x14118C6BF, at least 5 bytes, so it still fits CodeRedirect. The mod's injected code kFirstUnlessAdditionalLoadAction must change: (1) its store to 88 85 E0 00 00 00; (2) it must not read the family from rcx (rcx is live); read it from [r14] using rax (dead: 0x14118C6B7 reloads rax; flags dead: mov, mov, mov, call follow). Proposed: 3C 02 75 0D 49 8B 06 80 78 74 00 B0 02 74 02 B0 01 88 85 E0 00 00 00 (cmp al,2; jne store; mov rax,[r14]; cmp byte [rax+74h],0; mov al,2; je store; mov al,1; store: mov [rbp+0E0h],al).

facts.name: kOutputLoadActionResume
facts.note: store + 6 (not + 7): mov rax,[rbp+2B0h].

offset_changes.evidence: 1.005 RemoveLocalPlayer 0x144D695A8 is referenced at +0x2F0 of vtbl_UEndGameInstance 0x145BD4038, vtbl_UGameInstance 0x1469FCC20 and vtbl_UPlatformGameInstance 0x146A71980 (vtable starts found by their code references); 1.004 had the same three at +0x2E8.
1.005 store is mov [rbp+0E0h], al = 88 85 E0 00 00 00 (rbp-relative disp32) instead of mov [rsp+610h], al = 88 84 24 10 06 00 00.

0x14118C6B1. The store target is ViewFamilyOutput.LoadAction = var_598+0x18 (rbp+0xC8+0x18); the 32-byte output is handed to the TOverridePassSequence ctor (0x141641934) at 0x14118C84F, the same flow as 1.004.

In 1.005 rcx is reloaded with [r13+10h] at 0x14118C6A7 (between the Views[0] cmp and the setz) and is the argument of the call at 0x14118C6C6, so it is live and is not the family. r14 = View throughout (mov r14,rdx at 0x14118C61C; callee-saved across the two calls); [r14] = View->Family = the scene renderer's copy, with +0x74 copied at 0x1409EA20A. rax is dead after the store (reloaded at 0x14118C6B7).
The 1.005 SE override block 0x14118C65D..0x14118C6B7. The instruction mix differs (rbp frame, r14/r13), so there is no 125-byte equivalent with the same meaning.
Different register-save prologue in 1.005 (mov rax,rsp form; 0x20 frame).
